quantization: uint8 projection inside the Linf ball, same page_uint8/project helpers as the frozen runners
a_bar: min(a_clean_hard, max(a_clean_hard - xi, eta)); never above the clean native hard margin
clean_prefix: tokens from one clean Full generate, no appended EOS
L_compressed: mean soft margin of each train-ratio FastV path on that path's own greedy tokens
L_native_soft_anchor: mean softplus(a_bar - soft_margin of the fixed clean prefix under the attack Full forward)
L_FDP: mean softplus(clean_hard_margin - attack hard margin) on the fixed clean prefix; one-sided decision floor, not the soft-anchor
methods_are_not_renames: B-Native uses the soft anchor. native-FDP replaces only that term with the hard-margin floor. B+ adds lambda_gap * (-D) on r_train only.
D: m_full - 0.5*(m_fast_0.25+m_fast_0.35), each m is the mean soft margin of that path's own greedy tokens
lambda_rule: Record gradient L2 at delta=0 and at one fixed +1/255 probe. Freeze coefficients from the +1/255 probe only: lambda_full = grad_norm(L_compressed)/max(grad_norm(L_FDP),1e-12); lambda_gap = grad_norm(L_compressed)/max(grad_norm(L_conditional_gap),1e-12). delta=0 is recorded and does not set a second coefficient. No sweep and no retune after strict results.
calibration_order: sha256(sample_id) over pristine60; first id outside the dev12 whose native aux gradient is finite and nonzero
health_rule: the next three candidates in that order after the calibration id, none of them in the dev12
shard_rule: sorted dev ids by the frozen dev list order, shard i gets ids[i::4]
canonical_strict: valid_output AND nonzero AND uint8_linf<=8/255+1e-6 AND Full_text==clean_Full_text AND FastV_ANLS<0.5 AND disk_replay_matches
